prerequisites: A drawing with spot-height blocks whose insertion point Z is the elevation, or a points file
assertions: points from points, points_file or block references; z==0 dropped when drop_zero; duplicates by xy removed
fewer than 3 usable points fails with a message naming the sources
max_triangle_length > 0 leaves survey gaps open; the created surface has a non-zero triangle count
replace:true deletes an existing surface with the same name first
notes: Requires an appropriate drawing fixture. Private project runs are not public regression evidence.
